title: Zero bounded cube function
statement: For each natural number $n$, the zero bounded cube function is the real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube that takes the value $0$ at every point; its values lie in $[-1,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ specifying the cube dimension
